15.description: Confirms the NTD's current administrative & operational state.

16.description: Forces a lock/unlock of the DSL port. Will indentify modem connected to the right port (dataflow issues).

18.description:
This retrieves the current operational status of the UNI-D associated with a specific AVC.
NBN advice this operation should take between 10 and 20 seconds.

8.description:
FTTN/FTTB: Ensures Layer 2 connectivity test of NBN Co Network for given AVC ID terminated on the DLSAM port.
FTTC: Checks the bidirectional connectivity on the NCD UNI-D DSL service on the NBN Co Network.
FTTP: Checks the bidirectional connectivity of Fibre on the NCD UNI-D service on the NBN Co Network.
